name: Veggie Omelette
instructions: Whisk eggs with milk, salt, and pepper until combined.
Melt butter in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Sauté onion, zucchini, and asparagus 3-4 minutes until tender.
Add spinach and cook 1 minute until wilted. Push veggies to one side.
Pour egg mixture over entire pan. Let set around the edges, 2 minutes.
Sprinkle cheese over one half. Fold omelette in half over the filling. Serve.

substitutions.dairy_free: Use oat milk instead of milk, dairy-free butter, and vegan cheese.
substitutions.low_carb: Already low-carb — skip the milk for even fewer carbs.
substitutions.vegan: Use Just Egg or a tofu scramble base instead of eggs.
